title: How to Make Your Fitness Business Stand Out on Google | The Association of Fitness Studios

facts.fact: The article 'How to Make Your Fitness Business Stand Out on Google' was published on May 10, 2024.
The article describes Google Business Profile as a free tool that Google offers, which displays business hours, phone numbers, addresses, reviews, and photos directly in search results.
facts.quote: this is a free tool that Google offers that allows inquiring searchers to quickly review critical business information straight from their search results page

facts.fact: The article cites Search Engine Land's definition of SEO as 'the process of improving your website to increase its visibility in Google, Microsoft Bing, and other search engines.'
facts.quote: concisely summarizes SEO as “the process of improving your website to increase its visibility in Google, Microsoft Bing, and other search engines…”

facts.fact: The article states that the Google Map Pack lists relevant local businesses in the Google Map SERP features section for queries such as 'personal training studios near me'.
facts.quote: which lists relevant local businesses in the Google Map SERP (search engine results page) features section on queries like “personal training studios near me.”

facts.fact: The article identifies the author as Tim Mauk, a special FBA contributor, who started the GymSplash resource for small- to medium-sized fitness facility owners.
